scene_type: 2D (top-down view of an office chair seat; treat as planar)
time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0; frame i <-> t = i / 30.012937
coordinates: pixels, x to the right, y down, origin at the top-left of the image. *_stab columns = same point mapped to frame-0 image coordinates (camera drift removed).
summary: Handheld camera looks straight down on a mesh office-chair seat (left 2/3 of image) and the lower backrest (right 1/3). A hand on the left holds an acorn-shaped toy (white smooth dome + black textured cap with stem, cap pointing left), throws it to the right at frame ~38/39; it hits the backrest at frame 45, rebounds down-left, curves along the seat, rattles against the bottom seat-frame rail and the seat/back rail corner (frames 58-75), then travels up along the seat/back junction to the top rail (frame ~94), slides back down and is grabbed by the hand re-entering from the top-left (frames 108-115).

objects.name: toy_acorn
objects.description: acorn-shaped toy: pale white/blue-grey smooth dome + black textured cap (with a short stem). The only free-moving object. Tumbles, so its outline changes (dome-on, cap-on or side view).
objects.visible_frames: 0-115 (all); held in hand 0-38; free 39-107; grabbed by hand 108-115 (partly hidden by fingers)
objects.reference_point: visible centre of the whole toy (centre of its silhouette / whole-toy bounding box)

pixel_size.held_frame0_length_along_axis_px: 279 (cap end to dome end, horizontal = later throw direction; stem adds ~25 px more on the left)
pixel_size.note: Held toy is nearer the camera (raised in the hand) than when lying on the seat, so it appears ~20-30% larger. Sizes in flight 39-46 are inflated by motion blur (up to ~320 px along x).

objects.name: hand
objects.description: a person's right hand (and later forearm with a white smart-watch band). Only the hand/forearm is visible, never the body.
objects.visible_frames: 0-42 (holding toy at left edge, releases at ~38/39, withdraws left by 43; fingertips may remain at the very left edge x<40 until ~58); 100-115 (enters from top-left, reaches toy at 108, grabs it 108-115)
objects.track_file: tracks/hand.csv (coarse skin bbox; only valid=1 rows)

objects.name: chair_seat_mesh
objects.description: grey striped mesh of the seat, occupying x ~10-1290; horizontal stripes with period ~24-25 px (24 near right/top, 25-26 near left/bottom: mild perspective).

pixel_extents_frame50.seat_mesh_horizontal_extent_px: from left frame edge x~12 to seat/back rail x~1290 (~1280 px)
pixel_extents_frame50.seat_mesh_vertical_span_at_x600: y ~5 to ~1056 (nearly full height; seat is waisted, rails curve out of frame at left)

objects.name: seat_frame_rails
objects.description: dark-grey plastic seat frame: top rail (curving from top-left corner area down to y~120 at x~1200), bottom rail (y~975-1060), left rail at x~0-12, plus small plastic clips at top centre (x~925-1060, y 0-55) and bottom centre (x~960-1240, y~1010-1080). Black gaps between seat and backrest visible behind the rails at top (x~1080-1290, y<60) and bottom.

objects.name: seat_back_rail
objects.description: vertical dark plastic rail separating seat mesh and backrest: x ~1290-1325 (near-vertical, slightly curved; x~1275-1310 near top). The toy hits/rolls along it repeatedly.

objects.name: backrest_mesh
objects.description: tan/brown sunlit mesh of the backrest, x ~1330-1920, with diagonal stripes (period ~6 px horizontally-aligned slits) converging towards the left; carries large moving shadows (the person). The toy hits it at frame 45.

objects.name: shadows
objects.description: large soft shadow of the person on the seat and backrest, moving slightly; the toy casts a dark shadow next to it (often on its lower/right side). Not objects of interest but can confuse segmentation.

events.event: toy held in hand (cap left, dome right), nearly still (drifts < 60 px over 0-38)
throw starts (toy starts moving right; hand opening)
release: first free frame (toy separated from fingers); moves right ~37 px/frame then accelerates in image to ~260 px/frame by 45 (heavy motion blur 39-46)
impact with the backrest: rightmost point of the throw (centre x~1432); direction reverses between 45 and 46
rebound: moving left/down from the backrest
leftmost point of the rebound (x~732, y~735): x-direction reverses; toy curves to the right along the seat
reaches bottom seat-frame rail area (y~920-970) and x reverses (moves left 59-61)
lowest point (y~970), toy touches the bottom image edge 60-63; bounces off the bottom rail
hits the seat/back rail corner (x~1317), x reverses at 66
local leftmost (x~1178); from 74 on the toy moves upward (y decreasing) along the seat/back junction (x~1230-1290)
topmost point (y~160) near the top seat-frame rail; motion stops 94-97
toy starts sliding/rolling back down (y increasing ~15-20 px/frame) 96-108
fingers touch the toy (contact); grabbed 108-115, toy nearly still under the hand (y~430-460 at 110-115)
last frame: toy held by the hand at x~1250, y~441

camera.type: handheld, looking straight down; small slow drift, no zoom
camera.drift: image content moves left by ~23 px and down by ~4 px from frame 0 to 100, with ~0.7 deg rotation (scale change <0.5%). Frames 105-115: hand covers landmarks, estimate unreliable (hold the frame-104 values: dx -23.9, dy +0.8, rot 0.9 deg).
camera.use: for motion of the toy, the cx_stab/cy_stab columns already remove this drift; the correction is small (<25 px) compared with toy motion (tens to hundreds of px per frame).

perspective: near-orthographic top view of the seat; mild perspective (seat stripe period 24-26 px across the seat). The toy is raised above the seat while held (frames 0-38) and appears ~25% larger than when lying on the seat.

files.tracks/ball_raw.csv: automatic mask measurements (intermediate, less reliable in frames listed in notes)
